subject: science
domain: Motion and Stability: Forces and Interactions
skillName: How Pushes and Pulls Move Things

items.prompt:
A push or a pull is a
A) color
B) force that can move things
C) sound
D) smell
items.answer: B) force that can move things

steps: A push or pull is a force that moves objects.

items.prompt:
Which makes a toy car go farther?
A) A soft push
B) A hard push
C) No push
D) A whisper

steps: A stronger push moves the car farther.

items.prompt:
A pull moves an object
A) toward you
B) away from you
C) nowhere
D) up only

steps: A pull brings an object toward you.

items.prompt:
To make a swing go higher, you should push it
A) softer
B) harder
C) not at all
D) sideways only

steps: A harder push makes the swing go higher.

items.prompt:
If you push a ball to the left, it moves
A) right
B) left
C) up
D) it stays still

steps: The ball moves in the direction of the push.

items.prompt:
A bigger push makes a ball move
A) slower
B) faster
C) the same
D) backward only

steps: A stronger push makes the ball move faster.

items.prompt:
To fairly compare a soft and a hard push, you should
A) use a different toy each time
B) use the same toy both times
C) not push at all
D) close your eyes
items.answer: B) use the same toy both times

steps: Using the same toy makes the test fair.

items.prompt:
A box will not move with a small push. The best thing to try is to
A) push harder
B) stop pushing
C) whisper to it
D) pull it the same small amount

steps: A stronger push gives more force to move the box.
